facts.text: A portable Flag Pole 540 model has a height of 5.40 metres.
facts.quote: Reach new heights with the Flag Pole! Standing at an impressive height of 5.40 metres, it’s a true showstopper at car dealerships, offices and shopping malls.

facts.text: A telescopic portable flagpole can be adjusted to a height of 5 to 7 metres.
facts.quote: The height can be adjusted 5 to 7 metres, and once it is folded down it measures 2.2 metres and weighs approx 8 kg.

facts.text: Portable auto feather flags are available in heights from 3.1 metres to 5.2 metres.
facts.quote: Our auto feather flags are available in sizes from 3.1m tall up to 5.2m tall.

facts.text: A medium Blade-shaped portable flag uses a 3.1 metre tall pole for 3.1 metres total height.
facts.quote: Medium size ‘Blade’ shape – flag measures 2 metres in height and is installed on a 3.1 metre tall pole (3.1m total height)

facts.text: Portable Teardrop and Blade flags are available in 2.5, 3.5 and 4.5 metre heights.
facts.quote: Teardrop and Blade 2 Go flags, single or double sided, in 2.5, 3.5 and 4.5m heights
